title: EcoBreeze Bamboo Fiber Mug

claims_evaluated.reason: The term is a vague marketing label without citing specific environmental certifications, lifecycle assessments, or quantifiable sustainability metrics.

While bamboo fiber is a natural material, the claim lacks specific standards (e.g., ASTM D6400), timeframes, or conditions required for biodegradation, especially given the inclusion of a non-biodegradable silicone lid.

summary_reason: Weakest claim: "Eco-friendly" — The term is a vague marketing label without citing specific environmental certifications, lifecycle assessments, or quantifiable sustainability metrics. No contact/business info found.
